assertionResults.fullName: AC-1: actual concurrent processes claim one owner, preserving revision/dependencies and monotonically fencing recovered ownership
AC-2: matching unexpired heartbeat/transition ownership, reopened recovery, pause/cancel and bounded retries are enforced
AC-3: transactional idempotent outbox preserves dispatch uncertainty, requires remote reconciliation and retains receipts after restart
AC-4: invalid authority, state/action mutations and conflicting receipts reject without partial writes; no task ledger or live activation is modified
